records.name: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS)
records.description: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) Mumbai, established in 1936, is one of Asia's foremost institutes for social sciences education and research, recognized as a Deemed University of National Importance. It offers postgraduate and doctoral programs in social work, human resource management, public policy, education, health, and media, with a strong commitment to social justice and equity. TISS alumni occupy leadership roles across civil society, government, international organizations, and the corporate sector.

records.name: T.A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI)
records.description: T.A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI) Manipal, established in 1980, is a premier autonomous business school offering PGDM programs in general management, banking and financial services, marketing, and healthcare management. It is accredited by AACSB and consistently ranked among India's top 20 business schools, known for rigorous academics and strong industry interface. TAPMI is particularly recognized for its banking and financial services specialization and active industry partnerships in the BFSI sector.

records.name: Great Lakes Institute of Management
records.description: Great Lakes Institute of Management Chennai, established in 2004 with guidance from C.K. Prahalad, is a AACSB-accredited business school offering PGPM and PGDM programs. It is known for its one-year and two-year management programs with strong placements in banking, consulting, technology, and analytics sectors. Great Lakes has campuses in Chennai and Gurgaon and is recognized for bringing global management education standards to India.

records.name: Asian College of Journalism
records.description: Asian College of Journalism (ACJ) Chennai, established in 2000, is one of India's most respected journalism schools offering a postgraduate program in journalism. It is known for its rigorous reporting and writing training, strong visiting faculty from leading Indian and international newsrooms, and focus on digital journalism and data journalism. ACJ alumni work across India's and Asia's leading print, broadcast, and digital media organizations.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication
records.description: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication (SIMC) Pune is a leading media school under Symbiosis International University offering MBA, MA, and BSc programs in media and communication. It is known for its practical training infrastructure including professional TV studios, radio stations, and digital media labs, preparing students for careers in broadcast journalism, advertising, public relations, and digital media. SIMC consistently ranks among India's top communication schools.

records.name: Xavier Institute of Communications
records.description: Xavier Institute of Communications (XIC) Mumbai, established in 1969 by the Jesuits, is one of India's oldest and most respected media and communication training institutes. It offers certificate and diploma programs in journalism, advertising, public relations, photography, corporate communications, and digital media. XIC's Mumbai location, strong industry network, and Jesuit teaching tradition have made it a preferred destination for aspiring media professionals.

records.name: Times School of Journalism
records.description: Times School of Journalism New Delhi, associated with The Times Group, India's largest media conglomerate, offers postgraduate programs in journalism, advertising, and media management. The school provides students direct industry exposure through Times of India newsrooms and other Times Group properties. It is known for its practical, industry-embedded training that prepares students for immediate entry into print, digital, and broadcast journalism.

records.name: Symbiosis Law School
records.description: Symbiosis Law School Pune, established in 1977, is one of India's oldest and most reputed law schools, offering BA LLB, BBA LLB, LLM, and PhD programs under Symbiosis International University. It is known for its multicultural student environment, practical legal training, and strong placement record in legal and corporate sectors. Symbiosis Law School has campuses in Pune, Noida, Hyderabad, and Nagpur, providing legal education across India.

records.name: Government Law College
records.description: Government Law College (GLC) Mumbai, established in 1855, is India's oldest law college and one of its most prestigious, affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers LLB and LLM programs and is known for producing generations of India's most distinguished lawyers, judges, and public figures, including several freedom fighters and Supreme Court luminaries. GLC's rich heritage and Mumbai's status as India's legal and financial capital make it a highly sought-after institution for legal education.

records.name: Arena Animation
records.description: Arena Animation is one of India's largest animation and visual effects training networks, with centers in over 60 cities offering programs in 2D/3D animation, VFX, game design, and digital filmmaking. It provides short-term and long-term courses aligned with industry requirements, using global curriculum developed in collaboration with technology partners. Arena Animation has trained hundreds of thousands of animation professionals who work in Indian and international animation studios.
